title: World's Best Lasagna
why: The benchmark lasagna: beef, Italian sausage, and three cheeses.
freeze: Assemble in a freezer-safe pan and freeze before baking, or freeze baked portions. Thaw overnight before reheating.

title: Salisbury Steak Meatballs
why: A 2026 most-saved favorite with meatballs, mushroom gravy, and mashed potatoes.
freeze: Freeze the meatballs in their gravy. For the best texture, make fresh mashed potatoes when serving.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
why: Classic chicken, vegetables, and creamy gravy under pastry.
freeze: Freeze assembled and unbaked. Wrap tightly, label, and bake from thawed so the filling heats evenly.

title: Million Dollar Chicken Casserole
why: Rich, creamy rotisserie-chicken casserole and a 2026 most-saved favorite.
freeze: Freeze before baking and add any crisp cracker topping just before it goes into the oven.

title: Beef and Guinness Stew
why: Deep beef flavor, vegetables, and stout - ideal cold-weather food.
freeze: Cool completely, portion with plenty of broth, and freeze. Reheat gently; add a splash of stock if needed.

title: Chef John's Italian Meatballs
why: Beef-and-pork meatballs baked instead of fried, with 2,500+ ratings when compiled.
freeze: Freeze cooked meatballs on a tray, then bag them. They can be reheated directly in simmering sauce.

title: Chicken Cobbler
why: Creamy chicken casserole topped with Cheddar Bay-style biscuits.
freeze: Freeze the filling separately when possible. Add the biscuit layer fresh for the lightest, crispest topping.

title: Slow Cooker Shepherd's Pie
why: Meat, vegetables, gravy, and mashed potatoes - serious cold-weather comfort.
freeze: Cool and freeze in meal-size portions. Thaw overnight and reheat covered so the potatoes stay moist.

title: Brown Sugar Meatloaf
why: Old-school meatloaf with a sweet and tangy ketchup glaze.
freeze: Freeze the shaped loaf raw or freeze cooked slices individually. Keep extra glaze in a separate container.

title: Angela's Awesome Chicken Enchiladas
why: A creamy, cheesy, easy favorite from Allrecipes' 2026 most-saved lists.
freeze: Assemble without baking, cover tightly, and freeze. Thaw overnight; add fresh cheese before baking.

title: Slow Cooker Zuppa Toscana
why: Sausage, potatoes, greens, and creamy broth in one cozy bowl.
freeze: For best results, freeze before adding cream and greens. Stir both in after reheating the soup base.

title: Copycat Panera Broccoli Cheddar Soup
why: Rich cheddar-broccoli soup with nearly 2,100 ratings when compiled.
freeze: Cool fully and thaw in the refrigerator. Reheat slowly while stirring to help the dairy return to a smooth texture.

title: Million Dollar Soup
why: A 2026 breakout favorite with chicken, potatoes, bacon, cheese, and sour cream.
freeze: Freeze the soup base without sour cream or cheese when possible. Add dairy after reheating for a smoother finish.

title: White Chicken Chili Enchilada Casserole
why: A 2026 most-saved mash-up of white chili and enchilada casserole.
freeze: Assemble and freeze unbaked. Thaw overnight, then bake until bubbling and hot in the center.

title: Chicken Parmesan
why: One of Chef John's most-saved dinners, reportedly saved 140,000+ times.
freeze: Freeze breaded cooked cutlets without sauce. Add sauce and cheese during reheating so the coating stays crisper.

title: Hearty Italian Meatball Soup
why: Meatballs, vegetables, and pasta in a hearty broth.
freeze: Freeze the soup without pasta. Cook fresh pasta separately and add it to each bowl after reheating.

title: Italian Penicillin Soup
why: Chicken pastina soup with Parmesan and one of 2026's popularity leaders.
freeze: Freeze the broth, chicken, and vegetables without pastina. Add freshly cooked pastina and Parmesan when serving.

title: Instant Pot Chicken and Dumplings
why: Chicken-stew richness without an all-day simmer.
freeze: Freeze the chicken-and-gravy base. Make fresh dumplings after reheating for the best texture.

title: Aaahh! Potato Soup
why: Bacon, cheese, and potatoes - another 2026 most-saved entry.
freeze: Potatoes and dairy can turn grainy. If freezing, cool quickly, thaw overnight, and reheat gently while stirring.

title: Neiman Marcus Chicken Casserole
why: Chicken, bacon, and cheese made with ordinary pantry ingredients.
freeze: Assemble and freeze before baking. Hold back any crunchy topping and add it just before baking.

title: Famous Butter Chicken
why: Extremely simple baked chicken and one of 2026's most-saved recipes.
freeze: Freeze cooked portions tightly wrapped. Reheat covered, then uncover briefly to restore the crumb topping.

title: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup
why: Bright but still comforting, with chicken, rice, and lemon.
freeze: Freeze without rice when possible. Add freshly cooked rice after reheating to prevent a soft, swollen texture.

title: Chicken au Poivre
why: Creamy peppercorn chicken with steakhouse DNA.
freeze: Freeze chicken and sauce together, then thaw overnight. Reheat gently so the cream sauce does not separate.

title: Country Club Potatoes
why: Chef John's rich potato gratin and a 2026 most-saved side dish.
freeze: Freeze after baking and cooling completely. Reheat covered, then uncover at the end to refresh the browned top.

title: Cinnamon Roll Butter Swim Biscuits
why: A dessert-and-breakfast comfort bomb from 2026's most-saved recipes.
freeze: Freeze cooled individual biscuits. Thaw at room temperature and warm briefly; add fresh glaze after reheating.
